snippet.title: DüRT: Motocross Championship - Demo Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
DüRT: Motocross Championship is a late-90s style arcade motocross racer about riding skill, mid-air control, and high-speed dirt-track manoeuvres. Chunky low-poly bikes, warped textures, dithered skies, and a screaming two-stroke engine. If you grew up renting motocross games and never quite returned them, this one is for you.

The DEMO is out now. Free to play.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4677430/DRT_Motocross_Championship/
▶ Itch.io: https://sourpickle35.itch.io/durt-motocross-championshp

------------------------------------------

WHAT IT IS

Pick your bike, hit the dirt, and race. Speed-sensitive steering and throttle-controlled drifting mean you steer with the gas the way you should. Back it in on the brakes, send it off the ramps, and try to land it clean. A solo-developed love letter to the classic 3D motocross games, built around how the original PSX devs faked their physics and visuals: cheap, fast, and convincing.

FEATURES

- Throttle-controlled drifting and speed-sensitive steering
- Real projectile air with mid-flight control and air tricks
- A roster of classic-inspired bikes, each with its own engine character and handling
- Hand-rolled chase camera and a two-stroke engine that screams through a faux gearbox
- Retro late-PSX presentation: low-poly, dithered, 12-frame stepped animation
- Leaderboards and achievements

------------------------------------------

Made by a solo developer. No publisher, no crunch. Wishlisting on Steam is the single biggest thing that helps a one-person game get seen.

Follow development:
- Twitter/X: https://x.com/sourpickledev

See you on the ramp.

------------------------------------------
